standing: Leads the AFC East by 4 games

lastGame.title: Bills 26, Dolphins 9
stats: Josh Allen: 27-of-45, 304 yards, 1 TD, 2 INT; threw to eight different receivers and had no rushing attempts
DJ Moore: 8 catches, 91 yards, 4-yard TD; Khalil Shakir 5 catches for 101 yards; Ty Johnson 7 catches for 55 yards
James Cook III: 89 rushing yards and a 1-yard TD, his 10th rushing TD of the season
Tyler Bass: 4-of-5 on field goals (54, 43, 40, 28); a 54-yard miss ended his streak of 33 straight makes
Defense: 185 yards allowed, Miami 2-of-14 on third down, Kyle McCord 12-of-33 for 102 yards; Greg Rousseau 2 sacks, Damar Hamlin INT; no TD allowed since Nov 1

news.h: DJ Moore's knee scare looks minor
news.b: Moore left in the second quarter with a knee injury and was listed as questionable to return, but he came back and finished with 8 catches for 91 yards and a touchdown. He told NFL Network's Cameron Wolfe the knee buckle scared him, but the team checked him out and he's good. The Bills will watch him on the short week.

news.h: Kincaid and Benford sat out against Miami
news.b: TE Dalton Kincaid missed the game with thumb and ankle injuries, and CB Christian Benford missed it with a groin injury. With Thursday's game only four days away, their status for Kansas City is the main injury question this week.

news.h: Chiefs visit Thursday night; Bills favored
news.b: Kansas City (8-2) comes to Highmark Stadium on Thanksgiving night (8:20 p.m., NBC) after a 34-7 win over Arizona in which Patrick Mahomes threw for 324 yards and three TDs. FanDuel has Bills −2.5, total 50.5, moneylines Bills −142 and Chiefs +120, per Fox Sports.

news.h: Division lead grows to four games
news.b: Buffalo (9-1) is four games clear of New England (5-5), which was on its bye. The Jets (3-8) ended a five-game losing streak with a 27-24 win at the Chargers, and Miami fell to 1-9. The Bills play at New England on Dec 6.

source: ESPN, Yahoo Sports, Yardbarker and AP (via 104.5 The Zone) Bills-Dolphins recaps; Heavy on DJ Moore; Fox Sports on Jets-Chargers and Thanksgiving odds (FanDuel); CBS Sports standings and schedule (checked Nov 23).
